raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Only ranks that link to the Mooncake store mount a segment into it. In a
disaggregated deployment the decode ranks default to a chunk cache, so their
host memory never joins the pool no matter how free it is, and the shared
prefix cache is bounded by prefill-node DRAM alone. Under a long-context
agentic workload the store then evicts prefixes that the decode nodes had room
to hold.

## Modifications

A disaggregated decode rank now lends host memory to the Mooncake store when it
is configured the same way a prefill rank sizes its segment:
`MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE` explicitly set to a positive size, with
`MOONCAKE_MASTER` set. This mirrors vLLM's embedded store mode, where every
worker that has the store configured contributes `global_segment_size` and the
role only decides whether it reads or writes. The decode rank mounts a segment
but attaches no cache pool, so it neither reads nor writes KV.

The contributor is created in `build_kv_cache` and held by the scheduler for the
process lifetime, independent of the KV transfer backend (NIXL, MoRI or
Mooncake).

No capacity is lent when:
- the size is unset or 0;
- `MOONCAKE_STANDALONE_STORAGE=1`, where a local store service owns the node's capacity;
- the decode rank runs the external cache linker, which already mounts its own segment;
- `MOONCAKE_MASTER` is unset, in which case the size is ignored with a warning rather than failing startup.

**Behavior change:** deployments that already export
`MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE` and `MOONCAKE_MASTER` to decode workers (for
example one environment shared by all roles) will now mount decode capacity. To
opt out, leave the size unset on decode, set it to 0, or use standalone mode.

## Accuracy Tests

No change to generated output: the contributing rank attaches no cache pool and
performs no cache I/O, so the KV path is untouched.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

DeepSeek-V4-Pro, NVFP4, on GB300, disaggregated with 8 prefill nodes (TP8/EP8
per worker) and 4 decode nodes (TP16/EP16), agentic coding trajectories at
concurrency 1920, MTP with a fixed acceptance length, one hour of measurement
per run.

| | store capacity (host DRAM) | objects evicted | steady-state prefix hit | output tok/s | total tok/s | total tok/s/GPU |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| baseline | 4.5 TB (32 ranks x 140 GB) | 12.6M / 12.9M / 12.3M | 92.7-92.9% | 33,739 / 34,737 / 33,919 | 4,397,386 / 4,536,507 / 4,434,760 | 91,612 / 94,511 / 92,391 |
| decode sized | 6.7 TB (48 ranks x 140 GB) | 10.9M / 10.9M / 10.5M | 95.2% | 44,612 / 44,724 / 44,671 | 5,908,589 / 5,928,177 / 5,947,669 | 123,096 / 123,504 / 123,910 |
| mean | +50% | -15% | +2.4 pts | 34,132 -> 44,669 (+30.9%) | 4,456,218 -> 5,928,145 (+33.0%) | 92,838 -> 123,503 |

Three runs per arm. Run-to-run spread is 1.6% on the baseline and 0.3% with decode
capacity, well below the gap. Total tok/s counts cached prefill input, so it rises
faster than output tok/s: the extra capacity is exactly what stops those
prefixes from being evicted and recomputed.

The eviction count falls by less than the capacity grows because the store
evicts a fixed fraction of a now larger population each time it crosses its high
watermark. What changes is how long a prefix survives before its turn comes,
which is what the hit rate measures.

The two arms differ only in decode capacity and the branch under test; the image,
recipe, topology and acceptance length are identical.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Code Formatting with Pre-Commit](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-formatting-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests as outlined in the [Running Unit Tests](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#running-unit-tests-adding-to-ci).
- [x] Update documentation / docstrings / example tutorials as needed, according to [Writing Documentation](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#writing-documentation-running-docs-ci).
- [x] Provide throughput / latency benchmark results and accuracy evaluation results as needed, according to [Benchmark and Profiling](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/benchmark_and_profiling.html) and [Accuracy Results](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/accuracy_evaluation.html).

nodes.body: @ShangmingCai Could you help to review this? Thanks!

[by Claude Code] Review of `29ea9db`: 2 inline comments (2 functional) and 1 PR-level finding below. Each comment states its severity and confidence.

---

[by Claude Code] **Severity: style | Confidence: High**

**Issue**

The GB300 DeepSeek-V4-Pro results do not have enough repro detail:
- There are no prefill, decode, or router launch commands. The HiCache flags, the Mooncake env for each role and arm, and the DP attention setting are not stated. The "48 ranks x 140 GB" total holds only when `attn_tp_size` is 1, because `MooncakeStore` divides the segment size by `tp_size * pp_size`.
- There is no benchmark command. "Agentic coding trajectories" names no dataset, and the request count or duration settings are missing.

**Fix**

Add the exact launch commands for both arms, and the benchmark command with its dataset.

[by Claude Code] **Severity: functional | Confidence: High**

**Issue**

This check misses decode KV offload. With `--disaggregation-decode-enable-offload-kvcache`, `DecodeKVCacheOffloadManager` builds a `HiCacheController` with `--hicache-storage-backend`, and that controller creates its own `MooncakeStore` and segment. Offload forces `cpu_tensor` retraction and does not enable HiCache, so this function returns `False` for both the chunk cache and the decode radix cache. `build_kv_cache` then mounts a second segment through the contributor.

**Example**

Decode with offload, `--hicache-storage-backend mooncake`, `MOONCAKE_MASTER`, and `MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE=140gb`: each rank now runs two Mooncake clients and pins twice the host memory. On CPU, the two helpers return `False` and 140 GiB for this config.

**Fix**

When `disaggregation_decode_enable_offload_kvcache` is set, return `hicache_storage_backend is not None`. Add this case to `test_decode_cache_owns_store_matches_tree_cache_selection`.

[by Claude Code] **Severity: functional | Confidence: Medium**

**Issue**

This config leaves `dp_rank` at its default of 0. `MooncakeStore.__init__` names each rank's SSD offload dir `rank_{dp_rank}_{tp_rank}_{pp_rank}_{attn_cp_rank}`. With DP attention, every decode rank also has `attn_tp_rank=0`, so all DP ranks on a node share one dir. The comment in `MooncakeStore.__init__` says a shared dir silently truncates another rank's bucket files.

**Example**

Decode TP16 with DP attention, and `MOONCAKE_ENABLE_SSD_OFFLOAD=1` plus `MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_FILE_STORAGE_PATH` in the env shared with prefill: the 4 decode ranks on each node all use `rank_0_0_0_0`.

**Fix**

Pass `dp_rank=parallel.attn_dp_rank`, as `HiCacheController._generate_storage_config` does.

This is not true for the linker. On decode the chunk cache still goes through `create_unified_radix_cache` (the `ctx.disable_radix_cache` branch in `registry.py`), and the `elif enable_unified_cache_external_linker` there still attaches the linker, which creates its own `MooncakeStore(storage_config, mem_pool=None)` in `MooncakeDirectLinker.__init__`. So decode + mooncake linker + `cpu_tensor` retraction will mount two segments per rank.

`cpu_tensor` is also the default retraction for MLA/DSV4 decode since host_pool only supports MHA/SWA pools, so anyone who launches decode with the same linker flags as prefill will hit this.

Together with the decode offload case in the other comment, I think it's simpler and safer to just skip the contributor when decode has offload or the linker enabled, instead of mirroring the tree cache selection logic here, which is easy to get out of sync later.

FWIW `MooncakeDirectLinker` has the same gap with a TODO, but there it's because fixing it changes the persisted storage keys. The contributor never writes any key, so there is no compat concern here, just set it the same way as `_generate_storage_config`.

This case actually asserts the double mount, see my comment on `_decode_cache_owns_store`. Also `--hicache-storage-backend` + linker is rejected by `handle_hicache`, so `"mooncake"` with `linker=True` is not a valid combination anyway. Please make it `(True, False, "cpu_tensor", None, True, True)` and add the decode offload case as well.

     token_to_kv_pool_allocator: object
     disable_radix_cache: bool
     tree_cache: object
+    storage_contributor: object = None
 
 
 from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
@@ -259,6 +260,96 @@ def resolve_decode_retraction_backup(*, tp_worker: BaseTpWorker) -> str:
     return backend
 
 
+def _decode_cache_owns_store(
+    *,
+    disable_radix_cache: bool,
+    enable_hierarchical_cache: bool,
+    retraction_backup: str,
+    hicache_storage_backend: Optional[str],
+    external_linker: bool,
+) -> bool:
+    # Must match default_radix_cache_factory and create_unified_radix_cache:
+    # a chunk cache ignores store flags, and HiCache takes precedence over a linker.
+    if disable_radix_cache and retraction_backup != "host_pool":
+        return False
+    if enable_hierarchical_cache or retraction_backup == "host_pool":
+        return hicache_storage_backend is not None
+    return external_linker
+
+
+def _decode_store_contribution_bytes(
+    *, disaggregation_mode: str, cache_owns_store: bool
+) -> int:
+    if disaggregation_mode != "decode" or cache_owns_store:
+        # Other roles, and a decode cache with its own store, mount through it.
+        return 0
+    # Decode keeps no store-backed cache; it lends memory only when sized like prefill.
+    if not envs.MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE.is_set():
+        return 0
+    if envs.MOONCAKE_STANDALONE_STORAGE.get():
+        logger.info(
+            "Decode rank mounts no Mooncake segment: MOONCAKE_STANDALONE_STORAGE "
+            "leaves host capacity to the local store service."
+        )
+        return 0
+    if not envs.MOONCAKE_MASTER.is_set():
+        logger.warning(
+            "Ignoring MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE on a decode rank: lending "
+            "capacity needs MOONCAKE_MASTER."
+        )
+        return 0
+
+    from sglang.srt.mem_cache.storage.mooncake_store.mooncake_store import (
+        _parse_global_segment_size,
+    )
+
+    return max(0, _parse_global_segment_size(envs.MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE.get()))
+
+
+def _maybe_create_decode_storage_contributor(
+    *, server_args: ServerArgs, params, cache_owns_store: bool
+) -> object:
+    contribution_bytes = _decode_store_contribution_bytes(
+        disaggregation_mode=get_disagg().disaggregation_mode,
+        cache_owns_store=cache_owns_store,
+    )
+    if contribution_bytes == 0:
+        return None
+
+    from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import HiCacheStorageConfig
+    from sglang.srt.mem_cache.storage.mooncake_store.mooncake_store import (
+        MooncakeStore,
+    )
+
+    parallel = get_parallel()
+    storage_config = HiCacheStorageConfig(
+        tp_rank=parallel.attn_tp_rank,
+        tp_size=parallel.attn_tp_size,
+        pp_rank=params.pp_rank,
+        pp_size=params.pp_size,
+        attn_cp_rank=params.attn_cp_rank,
+        attn_cp_size=params.attn_cp_size,
+        is_mla_model=False,
+        enable_storage_metrics=False,
+        is_page_first_layout=False,
+        model_name=server_args.model_path,
+    )
+    # A segment without a cache pool, so no KV is read or written through it.
+    contributor = MooncakeStore(storage_config=storage_config, mem_pool=None)
+    logger.info(
+        "Decode rank lends Mooncake capacity (MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE=%d "
+        "bytes): attn_tp_rank=%d/%d, attn_cp_rank=%d/%d, pp_rank=%d/%d",
+        contribution_bytes,
+        parallel.attn_tp_rank,
+        parallel.attn_tp_size,
+        params.attn_cp_rank,
+        params.attn_cp_size,
+        params.pp_rank,
+        params.pp_size,
+    )
+    return contributor
+
+
 def build_kv_cache(
     *,
     server_args: ServerArgs,

+import pytest
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv_cache_builder import (
+    _decode_cache_owns_store,
+    _decode_store_contribution_bytes,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=1, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_MOONCAKE_ENV = (
+    "MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE",
+    "MOONCAKE_STANDALONE_STORAGE",
+    "MOONCAKE_MASTER",
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _clean_mooncake_env(monkeypatch):
+    for name in _MOONCAKE_ENV:
+        monkeypatch.delenv(name, raising=False)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("role", "owns_store", "env"),
+    [
+        # The segment default must not make every decode rank lend memory.
+        ("decode", False, {"MOONCAKE_MASTER": "m:50051"}),
+        (
+            "decode",
+            False,
+            {"MOONCAKE_MASTER": "m:50051", "MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE": "0"},
+        ),
+        # A local store service owns the capacity in standalone mode.
+        (
+            "decode",
+            False,
+            {
+                "MOONCAKE_MASTER": "m:50051",
+                "MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE": "140gb",
+                "MOONCAKE_STANDALONE_STORAGE": "1",
+            },
+        ),
+        # Shared role env without a master must not break decode startup.
+        ("decode", False, {"MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE": "140gb"}),
+        # These ranks already mount through their own cache path.
+        (
+            "decode",
+            True,
+            {"MOONCAKE_MASTER": "m:50051", "MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE": "140gb"},
+        ),
+        (
+            "prefill",
+            False,
+            {"MOONCAKE_MASTER": "m:50051", "MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE": "140gb"},
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_decode_lends_nothing_unless_sized_like_prefill(
+    monkeypatch, role, owns_store, env
+):
+    for name, value in env.items():
+        monkeypatch.setenv(name, value)
+    assert (
+        _decode_store_contribution_bytes(
+            disaggregation_mode=role, cache_owns_store=owns_store
+        )
+        == 0
+    )
+
+
+def test_decode_lends_the_configured_segment_size(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MOONCAKE_MASTER", "m:50051")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE", "140gb")
+    assert (
+        _decode_store_contribution_bytes(
+            disaggregation_mode="decode", cache_owns_store=False
+        )
+        == 140 * 1024**3
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("disable_radix", "hierarchical", "retraction", "storage", "linker", "owns"),
+    [
+        # A chunk cache drops store flags copied from prefill; decode must still lend.
+        (True, False, "cpu_tensor", "mooncake", True, False),
+        # Host-pool retraction builds HiCache, which owns a store only with a backend.
+        (True, False, "host_pool", None, True, False),
+        (True, False, "host_pool", "mooncake", False, True),
+        # A decode radix cache attaches the linker unless HiCache takes precedence.
+        (False, False, "cpu_tensor", None, True, True),
+        (False, True, "cpu_tensor", None, True, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_decode_cache_owns_store_matches_tree_cache_selection(
+    disable_radix, hierarchical, retraction, storage, linker, owns
+):
+    assert (
+        _decode_cache_owns_store(
+            disable_radix_cache=disable_radix,
+            enable_hierarchical_cache=hierarchical,
+            retraction_backup=retraction,
+            hicache_storage_backend=storage,
+            external_linker=linker,
+        )
+        is owns
+    )

With DP attention, every decode rank also has `attn_tp_rank=0`, so all DP ranks on a node share one dir. The comment in `MooncakeStore.__init__` says a shared dir silently truncates another rank's bucket files.

**Example**

Decode TP16 with DP attention, and `MOONCAKE_ENABLE_SSD_OFFLOAD=1` plus `MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_FILE_STORAGE_PATH` in the env shared with prefill: the 4 decode ranks on each node all use `rank_0_0_0_0`.

**Fix**

Pass `dp_rank=parallel.attn_dp_rank`, as `HiCacheController._generate_storage_config` does.

This is not true for the linker. On decode the chunk cache still goes through `create_unified_radix_cache` (the `ctx.disable_radix_cache` branch in `registry.py`), and the `elif enable_unified_cache_external_linker` there still attaches the linker, which creates its own `MooncakeStore(storage_config, mem_pool=None)` in `MooncakeDirectLinker.__init__`. So decode + mooncake linker + `cpu_tensor` retraction will mount two segments per rank.

`cpu_tensor` is also the default retraction for MLA/DSV4 decode since host_pool only supports MHA/SWA pools, so anyone who launches decode with the same linker flags as prefill will hit this.

Together with the decode offload case in the other comment, I think it's simpler and safer to just skip the contributor when decode has offload or the linker enabled, instead of mirroring the tree cache selection logic here, which is easy to get out of sync later.

FWIW `MooncakeDirectLinker` has the same gap with a TODO, but there it's because fixing it changes the persisted storage keys. The contributor never writes any key, so there is no compat concern here, just set it the same way as `_generate_storage_config`.

This case actually asserts the double mount, see my comment on `_decode_cache_owns_store`. Also `--hicache-storage-backend` + linker is rejected by `handle_hicache`, so `"mooncake"` with `linker=True` is not a valid combination anyway. Please make it `(True, False, "cpu_tensor", None, True, True)` and add the decode offload case as well.
